# Shot checklist — print this

**4 minimum · 8–14 ideal · landscape · originals only · name files by room**

## Must have
- [ ] The front of the house
- [ ] The main living room
- [ ] The kitchen

## Add what exists
- [ ] The street / driveway approach
- [ ] The entry or front hallway
- [ ] The dining area
- [ ] The office or study
- [ ] A connecting hallway or stairs
- [ ] The primary bedroom
- [ ] The primary bathroom
- [ ] Any other bedroom
- [ ] Any other bathroom
- [ ] The laundry / utility room
- [ ] The lower level
- [ ] The garage
- [ ] The patio, deck or porch
- [ ] The pool
- [ ] The yard or grounds
- [ ] The view (water, mountains, skyline)
- [ ] An aerial / drone shot, if you have one

## Before you send
- [ ] Every file is landscape
- [ ] Nothing has been filtered, cropped or brightened
- [ ] No people, pets or reflections of you
- [ ] Interiors shot in one lighting session, white balance locked
- [ ] Aerial (if any) is over the SAME side as the last ground exterior
- [ ] Aerial filename says which side: `rear-aerial.jpg`
- [ ] Front and rear elevations are not adjacent with nothing between them
